sloka: रथमादित्यसङ्काशं युक्तं परमवाजिभिः।आस्थाय त्रिशिरा वीरो वालिपुत्रमथाभ्ययात् ।। ६.७०.४ ।।
transliteration: rathamādityasaṅkāśaṁ yuktaṁ paramavājibhiḥ।āsthāya triśirā vīro vāliputramathābhyayāt ।। 6.70.4 ।।

translations.english: Then Trisira, seated on the chariot, effulgent as the Sun, yoked to the best horse marched towards Angada.
